verdict.rationale: Push-based sign-in with phishing defenses and admin-enforced MFA policies is a fair question for a password manager, but the evidence shows no push approval, number matching, location context, or admin MFA policy enforcement. The evidence covers only related features: TOTP code generation, Proton Sentinel account protection, and passkeys. These are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an IT admin, push-based sign-in includes phishing defenses — number matching, location context, and admin-enforced MFA policies
